points.point: New post only shows a chat, why
points.sentence: The chat IS the starting point -- the AI Agent creates your posts from what you type.

points.point: Where is the add video/media button
points.sentence: To add media to a post: open the draft and click Photo / Video.
To generate AI images, carousels, or videos: go to Videos, click "Create New Video," and pick a template.

verdict.reason: The entry explains that the chat is the starting point, where the add media button is (Photo / Video on the draft), and where AI images are generated.
